faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Straight answers about custom software development: cost, timelines, outsourcing, ownership and support.

items.a: Custom software development is designing, building and maintaining software made for one organisation's needs, instead of buying a ready-made product. Tailor-made software fits your exact workflows, integrates with your existing tools and evolves as your business changes.

items.q: How much does custom software development cost?
items.a: Most projects we deliver fall between $8,000 and $25,000 for an MVP, $25,000 to $75,000 for a business application, and $75,000 or more for enterprise platforms. The final cost depends on features, integrations, platforms and compliance needs. We provide a free, fixed-scope estimate after a short discovery call.

items.q: How long does it take to develop custom software?
items.a: Typical MVPs take 6 to 12 weeks. Large enterprise systems with many integrations usually take 3 to 6 months. We work in two-week sprints, so you see working software at the end of every sprint.

items.q: Why choose custom software over off-the-shelf products?
items.a: Off-the-shelf software is quick to start but forces your team into someone else's process, charges per seat and rarely integrates cleanly. Custom software is built around your workflows, you own it outright, and it scales without licence fees. If an existing product plus customisation is the better option, we will recommend that instead.

items.q: What does a custom software development company actually do?
items.a: It plans, designs, builds and supports software for one client's needs. Our designers map your workflows, engineers build the product, and code reviews and automated tests keep it reliable. You end up with software you own outright.

items.q: Do you offer consulting before development starts?
items.a: Yes. Every project starts with a consulting phase: we audit your workflows, systems and goals, then recommend whether to build, customise or integrate before any development budget is spent.

items.q: Can you help if we are building software for the first time?
items.a: Yes. We guide first-time founders and non-technical teams from scoping and wireframes through architecture, MVP launch and scaling, explaining every decision in plain language.

items.q: Do you work with startups, SMEs and enterprises?
items.a: Yes. We adapt delivery for startups that need speed to market as well as SMEs and enterprises that need strict compliance and high throughput.

items.q: Do you build custom software for healthcare and fintech?
items.a: Yes. We deliver custom healthcare software such as patient portals, EHR integrations and IVR systems with HIPAA-aware security, and custom fintech software such as lending, payments and reporting platforms with secure transactions and audit trails.

items.q: Can we outsource custom software development to you?
items.a: Yes. Many clients in the US, UK, Europe and the Middle East outsource custom software development to our team in India. You get senior engineers, overlapping working hours, weekly demos and direct access to the developers, at a lower cost than hiring locally.

items.q: Do you work with clients in my city or country?
items.a: Yes. We are a remote-first team based in India working with clients worldwide, including the US, UK, Europe and the Middle East. Calls are scheduled in your time zone, so you get the responsiveness of a local partner with the cost advantage of offshore delivery.

items.q: What software development engagement models do you offer?
items.a: We offer fixed-scope projects, dedicated development teams, staff augmentation and build-operate-transfer (BOT) models. We will recommend the right one based on your budget, timeline and in-house capacity.

items.q: What technologies do you use for custom software development?
items.a: We use proven stacks including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, .NET, PHP, Go, TypeScript, Flutter, React Native, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, chosen to suit your project rather than our preferences.

items.q: Can you integrate the software with our current ERP, CRM or other systems?
items.a: Yes. We regularly integrate with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, HubSpot, Stripe, QuickBooks, legacy databases and any REST or GraphQL API, so data stays consistent across your business.

items.q: Can you modernise our existing legacy software?
items.a: Yes. We handle legacy migration, cloud refactoring, monolith-to-microservices modernisation and frontend rebuilds, planned to avoid downtime for your users.

items.q: How do you ensure software quality, security and performance?
items.a: Every project includes code reviews, automated unit and end-to-end tests, CI/CD pipelines, OWASP-based security checks and load testing before release.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance and support after launch?
items.a: Yes. We provide SLA-backed support, security patching, infrastructure monitoring and continuous feature improvements from engineers who already know your codebase.

items.q: Will we own the source code and intellectual property?
items.a: Yes, 100%. All source code, designs and intellectual property are transferred to you, and an NDA is signed before any project details are shared.

softwareIntro.title: Custom Software Built Around the Way Your Business Works
paragraphs: Off-the-shelf tools make your team work around the software. Custom software works the other way round. As a <csd>custom software development company</csd>, we build tailor-made applications that follow your workflows, connect to the systems you already use and grow with your business, from internal tools to customer-facing portals and apps.

Our <sd>software development services</sd> cover the whole lifecycle: discovery, UX/UI design, engineering, testing, cloud deployment and long-term support. You work directly with senior developers, not account managers, in two-week agile sprints with a live demo at the end of each. See <work>software we have already shipped</work> or <about>meet the team behind it</about>.

Not sure you need fully custom software? That is the first question we answer. Sometimes customising an existing product or integrating the tools you already have is faster and cheaper than a new build, and we will tell you so. <contact>Share your project</contact> and get an honest recommendation within two business hours.

choosePartner.title: How to Choose the Right Custom Software Development Company
choosePartner.subtitle: Ranked lists of top software companies are a starting point, not an answer. Use these six checks to compare agencies, firms and consultancies before you sign.

items.title: Check real, recent work
items.desc: The best partners show live products and case studies similar to yours, not just logos. Ask to speak to a past client.

items.title: Meet the engineers, not just sales
items.desc: Strong teams let you interview the developers who will write your code, and those developers explain trade-offs in plain language.

items.title: Ask how scope and cost are fixed
items.desc: A reliable partner gives an itemised estimate and explains what changes the price, instead of one number on a sales call.

items.title: Confirm code and IP ownership
items.desc: Agency, firm or freelancer, the contract should transfer 100% of the source code and IP to you.

items.title: Look at process and communication
items.desc: Agile delivery, weekly demos and a shared board are signs of a mature team. Silence between milestones is a warning sign.

items.title: Plan for life after launch
items.desc: Software needs updates, monitoring and security patches. Choose a partner that offers support, not one that disappears after go-live.

choosePartner.note: We are happy to be measured against all six. <contact>Put us to the test</contact>.
